author: ValWood
body:
* **InterPro ID / label**


GO:1902977 | mitotic DNA replication preinitiation complex assembly | IEA with IPR045173

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**

cdt1

* **Description of issue**

Cdt1 functions in pre-replicative complex (pre-RC) assembly, not the preinitiation complex.
title: InterPro2GO issue:  IPR045173 not mitotic DNA replication preinitiation complex assembly
